title: Inspector X and the Eternal City
original_title: Inspector X and the Eternal City
overview: Jack X Inspector, and Alfred, his faithful sidekick, attempt to crack the case of a terrorist plot to blow up a casino in a future Singapore. As Jack’s voice-over explains, this city of SIN becomes the playground of the wealthy, where vice takes root. In this sci-fi-tech-noir, Jack X must contend with a familial twist as he attempts to uncover the mastermind behind this plot.
